Liam Support: flagging a P0 onboarding for customer Meridian Health (acct MH-407). Activation emails keep bouncing after SSO claim. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/69012
Nora CS: thanks. Renewal date? CSM? @Diego
Liam Support: renewal ~62 days. Diego is CSM. They're in an enterprise pilot with 2 teams.
Diego CS Lead: here. paste the error and the metadata URL used?
Liam Support: log snippet:
```
SAML: InvalidResponse - NameIDPolicy not accepted
SP metadata used: https://sso.meridianhealth.com/metadata.xml
```
Liam Support: reprovisioning didn't help. IdP says they pushed new metadata but still failing.
Nora CS: plan: immediate warm transfer to CS (within 30m), send customer-facing status, prepare a short technical fallback for their IdP admin. Diego, can you own handoff?
Diego CS Lead: I will take it. Diego -> actions: create shared invite with IdP admin cc'd, add triage notes to account, set target: pilot seats active by tomorrow EOD. I'll also tag AE for renewal watch.
Riley Solutions: drafting fallback steps now (concise):
- temporarily relax NameIDPolicy enforcement in test org
- run `redwood saml sync --tenant MH-407 --force`
- validate with `curl -sSf https://app.meridianhealth.com/_health`
I'll post a draft to #eng-platform for a quick thumbs up.
Tess AE: looping in AE to prep renewal outreach if activation slips. I have exec contact info.
Nora CS: I'll write two templates: ops note for IdP admin and an exec-friendly status. Liam please send the customer-safe note now: "We're investigating an SSO provisioning issue and working on a temporary workaround; we'll schedule a call for tomorrow morning PST." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Liam Support: sent at 4112233122. Customer replied: "Thanks, include our IdP admin and we'll be available tomorrow AM." :white_check_mark:
Diego CS Lead: recap and owners: Diego -> warm transfer + invite; Riley -> publish fallback doc; Nora -> log renewal watch & 7-day cadence; Tess -> prep AE outreach if needed. Setting account health to 'at-risk - onboarding'.
TaskBot: Task created: MH-407-warm-transfer assigned to Diego, due 4112234200.
Nora CS: capturing feedback: onboarding docs missing NameIDPolicy examples and IdP admin checklist. Filing to product board. I'll post a follow-up summary to this thread after the call. Thanks all. :pray:
